$description: Trail Design System tokens. Single source for landing (Astro), docs (VitePress) and dashboard (React + Tailwind v4). Three layers: primitive (raw values), semantic (roles), theme (colour roles per theme). Built by build.mjs, verified by check.mjs.

trail.checks.$description: Pairs that check.mjs measures in every theme that defines both tokens. [fg, bg] or [fg, bg, base]: base is what a translucent bg sits on (default surface). text >= 4.5, graphic >= 3, distinct >= 1.5 (heatmap low end, whose meaning also lives in the legend and tooltip).

primitive.$description: Raw values. Never referenced by components: only theme tokens point here. Colour steps are named by OKLCH lightness x100, so gray.18 is darker than gray.25 and the gap between two steps predicts contrast.

gray.$description: Trail black. Neutral greys with no hue, for the dark theme (dashboard, docs).

ink.$description: Paper and ink. Blue-tinted neutrals of the light theme and the landing (paper #f6f9fe, ink #06142e).

blue.$description: Trail blue. 57 (#0a72ef) is the brand blue and the Blue Ground.

green.$description: Success (77 dark, 51 light) and chart-2 (65 dark, 56 light).

out.$description: The one ease-out. Enter, exit, press, hover movement.

in-out.$description: On-screen movement from A to B (segmented thumb, cursor flight).

semantic.$description: Theme-independent roles: type, radius, motion, layout, z. Components use these names.

micro.$description: Floor. Chips, axis ticks, country codes. Never smaller.

small.$description: Secondary UI text, tabs, buttons, menu items.

body-strong.$description: Panel and section headings in product.

prose.$description: Docs reading text; inputs on phones.

heading.$description: Card titles, chart readout, journey name, marketing h3.

stat.$description: The one stat size. Tabular numerals.

numeral.$description: Doto marketing numerals and empty-state counts. 26px or larger.

row.$description: List rows, chips, menu items (inside a 12 popover with 6 padding).

popover.$description: Menus, chart tooltip card, code blocks, product windows.

pill.$description: Marketing buttons, badges, GitHub button, live pill.

copy-reset.$description: CopyButton returns to idle after this.

target-min.$description: Every control on a coarse pointer.

dark.$description: Trail black. Dashboard and docs default. Neutral near-black, no hue in any surface, line or shadow.

tint.$description: Quiet tinted band. Same as surface in dark.

control.$description: Boundaries that must read (checkbox, switch off). 3:1.

subtle.$description: Lowest text step. Still 4.5:1 on every surface.

primary.$description: The one filled action per view. Near-white on dark.

goal.$description: Goal marks. Yellow means goal and nothing else.

light.$description: Paper. The landing page and the light mode of dashboard and docs.

tint.$description: Mist. Quiet tinted band on marketing.

goal.$description: Yellow fails on paper, so goal marks go amber with a darker stroke.

blue-ground.$description: Blue Ground. Marketing hero band, CTA band, footer and the demo card only. Never hosts charts: embed a dark product window instead. All text is white; hierarchy comes from size and weight, because no grey text passes on #0a72ef.

muted.$description: No grey on blue: muted is white.

ring.$description: White ring on blue: 4.5:1. Yellow stays for goals.

goal.$description: Goal ring on blue: 3.1:1, graphic only.

scrim.$description: Header scrim top stop over hero art.

glass.$description: Frosted paper header once scrolled off the hero.
